purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) processing system - inpatient receipt print file creation for JMA ORCA standard medical billing software
purpose.summary: ORCR0720 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that creates print files for inpatient (入院) receipts. It reads multiple indexed receipt data files (RECE62, RECE631, RECE661, RECE68, RECE69, RECE67) and produces formatted output for medical insurance claim submissions. The program handles various insurance types, hospitalization history, and prefecture-specific items.

notable_features: 52 COPY statements with REPLACING clauses for code reuse
119 CALL statements indicating heavy use of subprograms
ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED files with DYNAMIC and SEQUENTIAL access
No COMP-3 usage (PIC 9 fields without COMP-3)
Multiple OCCURS tables for insurance data
Fixed-format source with some lines exceeding 72 columns (31 long lines)
verdict.notes: Comments are encoded in EUC-JP (Japanese) rendered as latin-1 mojibake in the archived form. The file is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system used by Japanese medical institutions. No COMP-3 is unusual for a financial/billing system but consistent with GnuCOBOL ORCA codebase style. Source truncated at 16000 chars; full file is 8166 lines.
